title: affected-sites: Operators shown offline in the vault but absent from impact.json
description: EPFL own homepage at 08:19:13Z: "Some EPFL websites are unavailable" after a security alert (epfl-site). Canada: "Some Government of Canada websites have been temporarily taken offline as a precaution" (globalnews-ottawa-sites, AI Minister Evan Solomon). Australia: government sites including the ACSC pulled offline (abc-au-gov-sites-exposed, abc-au-politics-live; cyber.gov.au capture failed ERR_ABORTED). Switzerland: universities of Geneva and Fribourg, EPFL, Basel-Stadt canton (20min-fr-suisse-romande, letemps-php-sites-debranches). Germany: Laender, hospitals, universities still offline Thursday (tagesspiegel-dpa-noch-offline). Czech government site offline 17:00 GMT and Internet Archive (reuters-factbox-websites-offline). None of these are rows in impact.json.
